instruction: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.

arguments.note: The slices stand upright beside the toaster. I will grasp one near its upper edge so its lower edge remains clear for insertion.

arguments.hindsight: I should have used a narrower, deeper grasp on the first upright slice, verified retention before transport, and planned a reachable insertion or handoff before lifting it. Repeated shallow grasps and large wrist rotations near the toaster worsened the layout.
arguments.reason: I could not secure and insert the bread. Repeated grasp attempts displaced the slices, and recovery approaches were obstructed or unreachable.
